    aTokens = input_lines[1].split()
    bTokens = input_lines[2].split()

    b = [int(x) for x in bTokens]

    aliceScore = 0
    bobScore = 0

        aliceScore += min(a[1], b[2])
    if a[2] != 0:
        aliceScore += min(a[2], b[0])

    bCopy = b[:]

    if bCopy[0] != 0:
        match = min(bCopy[0], a[1])
        bobScore += match
        bCopy[0] -= match

            match = min(bCopy[0], a[0])
            bobScore += match
            bCopy[0] -= match
    if bCopy[1] != 0:

        bobScore += match
        bCopy[1] -= match

        bobScore += match

        if bCopy[2] != 0:
            match = min(bCopy[2], a[2])
            bobScore += match
            bCopy[2] -= match

    print(f"{t - bobScore} {aliceScore}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
